## What

1. **The test data set.** UTAT's existing captures if they will share them,
   otherwise synthetic frames, in the camera's real format. Every later RTL
   milestone is tested against these passes, so this is the most reused thing
   in the project.
2. **The data budget**, agreed in writing with UTAT.

## The budget as currently proposed

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| ROI | 256 x 320 |
| Sample | 14-bit, stored in 2 B |
| Rate | about **11.4 MB/s** (~70 frames/s) |
| Pass | 2 min, about **1.4 GB** |

**Conflict to settle:** the September 2026 client meeting quoted **20 MB/s**,
1.2 to 2.4 GB per pass, and a Camera Link or GigE camera. This plan assumes a
USB 3.0 camera. Ask UTAT to confirm the camera model, the rate and the interface
together, because storage size, DMA throughput and the CCSDS 123 throughput
target all scale with them.

## Done when

- [ ] Data set committed (Git LFS if large) with a README giving the format:
      byte order, header if any, frame dimensions.
- [ ] At least one synthetic pass, plus at least one real capture if UTAT has one.
- [ ] Budget agreed with UTAT and recorded in `docs/DATA_BUDGET.md`, including
      the camera model and interface.

## Carries over

Replaces `D-01` (camera interface decision). The synthetic and malformed frames
in `_superseded/V-02-camera-model.md` are worth reusing: constant, gradient,
noise, and a truncated frame.
